parsed.rationale: All three participating records are unnamed extensions (kind: 'extension', name: '') on the Apple Foundation type ProcessInfo.ThermalState, and every structural_evidence field is null — no Jaccard score, no shared_field_count, and no differing_slots were computed. The pipeline matched solely on the extended type name, not on any member overlap. Without field-level evidence it is impossible to distinguish legitimate partitioning of extension members across DebugPanel and Wallpaper packages from actual duplication; acting on shape alone would risk merging extensions that serve distinct concerns (debug metrics in DebugPanel vs. throttling quality signals in Wallpaper/Throttling/QualitySignal.swift). The coincidence is structural only.
